description: The University of Seville publishes UTHECA_USE, 989 paired observations of outdoor microclimate, urban form and personal thermal perception in Seville. Data cover warm months from 2023 to 2025. Fifty-five main variables include air and globe temperature, humidity, wind, UTCI, clothing and subjective comfort; supplementary records include surface temperatures of materials. The idUS repository provides CSV and Excel files with a codebook and states CC BY 4.0 in its item API. Access is free. These city observations can calibrate street-scale heat and pedestrian-comfort simulations or test adaptation measures. Warm-season sampling and local morphology limit cold-season or other-city transfer. Imputation methods and linked surface subsets require care. No individual responses or files were downloaded. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. Its use is limited to the sampled seasons and measured urban settings.
name: UTHECA_USE Seville thermal perception
notes: G4-0506; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
